task.description: WF-03 Step 4 regression test for ISS-0930. Write test/letflow/scripts/qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test.exs exactly per section 6 of the validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0930-seed-service-task-endpoints.md (uses Letflow.Definitions.Graph.Node with node_type: :SERVICE_TASK, ServiceTask.parse_config_from_node_attributes/1, Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator.validate/2 with stub public resolver, sample value 'sample1', method atom comparison, no single-brace placeholders, static content assertions on the seed scripts/helper). Follow the style of the existing test/letflow/scripts/seed_swiftroute_definition_test.exs. FAIL-FIRST PROOF is mandatory: (a) run the new test against the PRE-FIX fixtures and show it fails - do this WITHOUT mutating the worktree: create a throwaway `git worktree` of origin/main plus only the new test file (run `mix deps.get`/ share _build as needed; if too heavy, copy the main-branch versions of test/fixtures/qa/*.json and scripts/*.sh into a temp copy) and quote failing counts; remove that throwaway worktree after; (b) run it on this branch and show it passes. Because the fix is a data fix (not a new module), ALSO do one or two targeted mutations in a throwaway copy - e.g. revert one node's endpoint to 'POST /x', set one endpoint to http://, leave one single-brace placeholder, drop one method - and record that the test fails for each; revert/remove the throwaway and verify `git status --porcelain lib/ test/ scripts/` in context.worktree shows only your new test file. Do not write a test spec .md unless the repo convention for WF-03 tests requires it (check a prior WF03 run's step-04 handoff). Work in context.worktree only; do not commit; set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'.
